summary.text: Gregg Amore is the incumbent Democratic Secretary of State, seeking a second term unopposed. A former East Providence high school history teacher and athletic director and a former state representative, he has declined a U.S. Justice Department demand for Rhode Island's unredacted voter file, a dispute now on appeal.

paragraphs.text: Taught at East Providence High School and served as athletic director for the East Providence School Department before holding elected office.

sources.title: Flanked by labor and Democratic leaders, RI Secretary of State Gregg Amore kicks off reelection bid
DOJ orders Amore to preserve 2024 election records in ongoing voter data fight
